again.speaker: doctor
lines: Back so soon, %PATIENT_FIRST%? I'm starting a file on you.
I've buried people who were in here less often than you.

excuse.speaker: patient
lines: It wasn't my fault this time.

verdict.speaker: doctor
lines: It never is. Out you go.
Stay out of trouble. Or at least out of my ward.
Next time bring a note from whatever hit you.
